With eta1=1, eta2=2/3 and opposite rank-one oracle, s1=−sgn(s0)/2, s2=sgn(s0)/6. Since d2=sqrt2/6 < smallest eigenvalue(X2)=1/3, the thresholding and efficient ranks both become full 2 at t=3; for |s|<=1/6 inequality 1/2−|s|−sqrt2|s|>0 is invariant. Full oracle maps s to −(1+sqrt2)s, giving recurrence s_t=(t−3−2sqrt2)/(t+1)s_{t−1}, t>=3, and exact gamma product with objective exponent 8+4sqrt2. Exact line search from any nonzero diagonal start reaches I/2 at t=1. Independent symbolic gamma-product iterations through t=24 confirmed the recurrence and invariant range.
